source_title: RIDOT Rules & Regulations for Overweight/Oversize Vehicles
verify_reasons: RIDOT publishes no formal superload class or numeric superload threshold; heavy/large loads are reviewed case-by-case by the Chief Engineer, so superload dimensions are left null.
The regulation gives width, length, and overhang escort thresholds but no numeric overheight escort trigger — height escorts are applied at RIDOT discretion.
Legal gross weight (80,000 lbs) is the statutory/federal default; RI statute codifies axle load 22,400 lbs (31-25-13) but not restated as a single gross number in the permit text.

superload_thresholds.note: RIDOT publishes no fixed superload threshold. Moves in excess of maximum weight/dimensions are reviewed by RIDOT engineers (Office of the Chief Engineer) for routes, overhead clearances, and bridge integrity; annual crane blanket caps are 12' wide / 13'6" high / 95' long / 130,000 lbs.

width.note: one escort for overall width 12'0"-14'6"; escort precedes on undivided highways, follows on divided
two escort vehicles required for width over 14'6"

length.note: two escort vehicles required for overlength over 90'0"

single_trip.fee_formula: Non-divisible trip fee $20.00. Out-of-state registered vehicles: trailers $30 flat; 2-4 axle trucks $10 per 1,000 lbs over legal (max $300 for 76,650 lbs); tractors $10 per 1,000 lbs over legal (max $200 for 99,000 lbs, $250 for 99,000-104,800 lbs); transfer fee $10. RI-registered vehicle fees are reflected in the registration fee.
single_trip.note: Single trip permits are issued for one specific move. Fees are not prorated; all permits expire March 31.

annual.note: Blanket permit $100 for intrastate moves (3- or 6-month), up to 75' long and 11'11" wide; all larger moves require an individual special permit.

movement_restrictions: No moves authorized from sunset Friday to sunrise Monday, or on listed state holidays; if a holiday falls midweek, travel allowed up to 12:00 noon the day before
Daylight travel only: 30 minutes before sunrise to 30 minutes after sunset; no night travel except envelope/permitted exceptions (cranes may travel sunrise-7:00 AM windows)
Minimum 1,000 ft spacing between oversize permitted vehicles traveling the same direction
Buildings may be moved Tuesday-Thursday only and require two escorts plus police escort from each city/town on the route
Jamestown Bridge (22' curb-to-curb): loads over 9' wide require police to halt traffic on one end before crossing
notes: RI statutory limits: width 102" (8'6"), height 162" (13'6"), single vehicle length 40', semi-trailer 48'6", trailer/semi in a 3-unit combo 28'6" each, axle load 22,400 lbs.

Overhang: no escort under 15' with proper flags; one escort at 15'+ overhang (a second may be required on a 2-lane undivided road when overhang is 15'+ rear and width is 12'+). Cranes on own power over 12' wide need two escorts intrastate.
